Score a completed session (weighting/routing/steering/flow)

Reads the auto-exported history record for a session, correlates it with the task store, and scores task weighting (planner estimates vs observed outcome), model routing, file-scope steering, and flow. Persists a comparable report to .wombo-combo/evals/&lt;wave-id&gt;.json. Defaults to the most recent session when no wave ID is given.

```sh
woco eval [wave-id] [flags]
```

Read-only.

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `wave-id` | no | Wave ID to score (defaults to the most recent session) |

## Global flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output` | `-o` | string | `"text"` | Output format: text (default), json, or toon. Values: `text`, `json`, `toon`. |
| `--force` |  | boolean | `false` | Force overwrite / skip safety prompts |
